profile.stagger_pattern: 7 seats, 4-year terms, elected in even-numbered years on the 1st Tuesday in November, taking office January 1 following. Three residency precincts (Eastern, Central, Western) with 2 seats each, plus one at-large seat that serves as Mayor. The Mayor + one seat per precinct (4 seats) are elected in the 2016/2020/2024 cycle; the other seat per precinct (3 seats) in the 2018/2022/2026 cycle. Precinct seats are voted on CITYWIDE (the canvass CSVs show all three precincts casting ballots in each precinct race) - the precinct is a residency district, not a separate electorate.

run_log.detail: Registry Virginia entry re-verified. CONFIRMED: results.elections.virginia.gov serves only the 2022 November General folder; Poquoson is top-level as an independent city and that page fetched cleanly (3 council races). CONFIRMED DEAD: VPAP - all five date slugs (20161108/20181106/20201103/20221108/20241105) returned HTTP 202 with 0 bytes to curl+browser UA and HTTP 403 to WebFetch. Zero usable of five, worse than the '3 of 6 empty' the registry records. CORRECTION: 'historical.elections.virginia.gov deep links all 404 - non-scriptable' is WRONG. Constructed locality/contest paths do 404, but the NUMERIC form https://historical.elections.virginia.gov/elections/view/{contest_id}/ works, and its CSV API https://va2.elstats.civera.com/api/download_contest/{id}_table.csv?split_party=false returns full precinct-level canvass data. Contest ids are contiguous per election and alphabetical-ish by locality, so one seeded id lets you sweep the neighbourhood; the site's /search is a Next.js SPA and is useless to a fetcher. This single correction sourced every cycle in this city.

CENSUS ENTRY WRONG. Census recorded NO working archive for Poquoson and ci.poquoson.va.us robots.txt as 'timing out on repeated attempts'. In fact https://www.ci.poquoson.va.us/ and /robots.txt both return HTTP 200 to plain curl with a browser UA, first try. The site is CivicPlus/CivicEngage. robots.txt disallows only /admin, /activedit, /Search, /Map, /CurrentEvents, /RSS.aspx - the Archive Center, Document Center and department pages are all permitted. poquoson.gov and poquosonva.gov do not resolve in DNS; ci.poquoson.va.us is the only host. Calendar established verbatim from /252/City-Council: 'The Poquoson City Council is composed of 7 members ... serve 4 year terms. Elections are held in even numbered years on the 1st Tuesday in November. ... The City is divided into 3 precincts with each precinct having 2 council representatives. One representative is elected at large and serves as City Mayor. Persons elected to City Council take office on the first day of January following the election.' The May->November shift under SB 1157 does NOT apply here - Poquoson has voted in even-year November throughout, confirmed by official contests found for 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024. No COVID-postponed May 2020 election.

MAYORALTY, established from source: it is BOTH its own ballot line AND one of the 7 council seats. The city charter description says one of the seven members is 'elected at large and serves as City Mayor'; the state canvass carries it as a separate office, 'Mayor - Poquoson City' (contest 144755 in 2020, 161542 in 2024), distinct from the three 'City Council - Poquoson City - {Central|Eastern|Western}' contests. So there is no separate Mayor office outside the council, but there IS a dedicated Mayor ballot line for the at-large seat. Recorded as seat_label 'Mayor (At-Large)' with role mayor. SEAT SCHEME: the precinct races are voted on CITYWIDE - each contest CSV shows all three precincts (1-Central, 2-Eastern, 3-Western) plus the central absentee precinct casting ballots in every precinct race. The precinct is a residency district, not a separate electorate. Cycles retrieved: 2018-11-06 contests 134262 (Central: Charles Macon Southall III), 134263 (Western: Carey Lawson Freeman), 134264 (Eastern: Herbert Roberts Green Jr) - all unopposed, write-ins only. 2020-11-03 contests 144752 (Western: David Alan Hux), 144753 (Eastern: Jana Caranfa Andrews), 144754 (Central: Thomas Joseph Cannella II), 144755 (Mayor: Gordon Clair Helsel Jr) - all unopposed. 2022-11-08 from the state portal AND contests 156790/156791/156793 (Western: Alison Gnatowsky Fox; Central: Southall; Eastern: Freeman) - all unopposed. 2024-11-05 contests 161542 (Mayor: David A. Hux 4,014 def. Tanner R. Showalter 3,354), 161543 (Central: Keith A. Feigh), 161544 (Eastern: Anjie L. Emmett), 161545 (Western: Jeanne Darby Hubbard). 2024 is the only contested race in the whole window.

ACFR SPINE - the decisive source, and it is ON the city domain the census called unreachable. https://www.ci.poquoson.va.us/Archive.aspx?AMID=37 lists the full ACFR series FY2012-FY2025. The archive item URL Archive.aspx?AMID=37&Type=&ADID={n} serves the PDF directly BUT ONLY WITH curl -L; without -L it returns 0 bytes. ADIDs: 91=FY2018, 95=FY2019, 99=FY2020, 103=FY2021, 105=FY2022, 108=FY2023, 112=FY2024; FY2025 is only at /DocumentCenter/View/4275. Every one carries a 'City Council' principal-officials page naming the mayor, the vice mayor and all five other members, extracted verbatim with pdftotext -layout. As-of June 30 each year, so it is a snapshot not a span. Compositions: FY2019 & FY2020 = Hunt(M), Freeman(VM), Andrews, Cannella, Green, Southall, Hux. FY2021 & FY2022 = Helsel(M), Freeman(VM), Feigh, Andrews, Green, Southall, Hux. FY2023 & FY2024 = Helsel(M), Freeman(VM), Bunting, Emmett, Feigh, Hux, Southall. FY2025 = Hux(M), Bunting(VM), Emmett, Feigh, Freeman, Hubbard, Southall. Diffing consecutive years is what exposed all three mid-term changes below.

THREE mid-term changes, all invisible in the election record, all caught by ACFR diffing. (1) CENTRAL SEAT A: Thomas J. Cannella II won the seat unopposed on 2020-11-03 for a 2021-2024 term, appears in the FY2020 ACFR (6/30/2020), and is GONE from the FY2021 ACFR (6/30/2021), where Keith A. Feigh sits instead. Feigh never appears on a ballot until 2024, so he entered by appointment sometime between 2021-01-01 and 2021-06-30; the exact date and Cannella's exit mode are unresolved. No Poquoson council contest exists on the 2021-11-02 ballot (swept contest ids 150812-150822; only Treasurer, 150818), so there was no special election that year. (2) EASTERN SEAT A: Jana D. Andrews won unopposed in 2020 for a 2021-2024 term, is present at 6/30/2022 and gone at 6/30/2023, replaced by Anjie L. Emmett, who then won the seat outright on 2024-11-05. A search result asserts Emmett was appointed in June 2023 and confirmed at a special election later that year; that assertion is UNVERIFIED - the WAVY candidate profile that carries it returns HTTP 403 to curl, and I did not locate the 2023 contest id block. Recorded as appointed, medium confidence. (3) WESTERN SEAT B - THE WINNING-IS-NOT-HOLDING CASE: Alison Gnatowsky Fox won the Western seat unopposed on 2022-11-08 (confirmed twice, in the state portal page and contest 156790) for a 2023-2026 term. She appears in NO source as ever holding it. The FY2023 ACFR (6/30/2023) shows Debra D. Bunting in the Western seat, the FY2025 ACFR and the current council page both show Bunting as Western with a term expiring 2026-12-31 - i.e. Bunting holds the term Fox won. Per the brief's rule, Fox gets no tenure row. Bunting is recorded as appointed 2023-01-01, medium confidence; whether Fox declined before being sworn or resigned within the first months of 2023 is NOT established and the handover date is soft.

SEAT-CONTINUITY ODDITY, verified twice and left as recorded: Carey L. Freeman won the WESTERN seat on 2018-11-06 (contest 134263) and the EASTERN seat on 2022-11-08 (contest 156793 and the state portal page). Both records are official canvasses and agree with the current council page, which lists Freeman as Eastern Precinct. Poquoson redistricted between those cycles (the 2022-10-27 electoral board minutes list 'Redistricting' among the school-of-instruction topics), which is the likely explanation, but I did not source the boundary change itself. Consequence for the panel: Freeman's 2019-2022 service and his 2023-2026 service are two DIFFERENT seats, so they are two tenure rows on two seat_labels, not one continuous row. His Western seat passed to Fox/Bunting and the Eastern seat he took was Green's. Seat count is 7 in every year, matching the charter. VICE MAYOR: Poquoson does designate one - Freeman is named 'Vice Mayor' in the FY2018 through FY2024 ACFRs and Bunting in FY2025 and on the current council page ('Debra Bunting, Vice-Mayor/Western Precinct'), so it is tracked as its own seat. The Freeman->Bunting handover is placed at 2025-01-01, the organizational meeting after the 2024 election; the two ACFRs bracket it at 6/30/2024 and 6/30/2025 but do not date it. Day-of-week checks were not applicable - no narrative date was relied on. Every name recorded comes from locally extracted PDF text or a canvass CSV, not from a page summary.

Routes tried and failed, recorded so they are not rediscovered. Ballotpedia fetches fine by curl but has only ONE Poquoson page in the window, /Poquoson_County,_Virginia,_elections,_2022 (candidate lists, no results); the 2016/2018/2020/2024 equivalents 404. The city's Electoral Board minutes series (/353/Electoral-Board-Minutes, Jan 2020 onward, ~55 PDFs) is fetchable and clean but is PROCEDURAL ONLY - the November canvass minutes record that 'a canvass was conducted of each precinct and the election results were verified' and name no candidate; do not spend budget there. The CivicPlus AgendaCenter page returns 200 but is JS-rendered with zero hrefs and no CIDs beyond CID=12; the dated Search endpoint returns 200/113KB with no ViewFile links at all; /DocumentCenter index is likewise JS-only. The CivicPlus site search /Search/Results is DISALLOWED by this host's robots.txt, so the Norfolk technique was not available here. Council minutes were therefore never reached - the ACFR series made them unnecessary.

56 seat-years (7 seats x 8 years) all sourced, plus 8 vice-mayor seat-years. Zero gaps. The 2016-11-08 cycle (Mayor Hunt, Hux, Andrews, Cannella; terms 2017-2020) was NOT retrieved and is flagged, but its blast radius on this panel is zero: the 2019 and 2020 seat-years of all four holders are sourced directly by the FY2019 and FY2020 ACFRs, and three of the four were re-elected in 2020 by official canvass. Their tenure rows start at the 2019-01-01 panel boundary rather than their true 2017-01-01 start. The suspected 2023-11-07 special election that would have confirmed Emmett is likewise flagged and unretrieved; its blast radius is zero because her 2023 and 2024 seat-years are sourced by the FY2023 and FY2024 ACFRs.
